method: One session (Claude Sonnet 5.5), no sub-agents, working to BRIEF.md in this folder: sources gathered, coverage table by script (gen-coverage.py), nouns first, rules with script-copied quotations and srcrefs locators, hand-written tests, seat layer last. Vintages are inputs; where no text is deposited for a date the function answers NOTHING.
edition_encoded: Telecommunications Act 1999 (Singapore), 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation headed 'version in force from 2/10/2026', as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/TA1999.txt, with the Act's earlier printed versions from the e-Gazette (Revised Edition 2000, Acts 10 of 2005, 19 of 2011, 22 of 2016, 30 of 2016 and 15 of 2017, their commencement notifications S 76/2005, S 33/2012, S 461/2016 and S 14/2017, the 2020 Revised Edition as printed). Instruments: the 40 texts on IMDA's Telecommunications Act 1999 page, in ten groups (Ship Station Operators (Rg 1), Class Licences (Rg 3), Cable Detection Workers (Rg 4), Radio-communication (Rg 5), Dealers (Rg 6), Exemption from sections 33, 34(1)(b) and 35 (N 1), Composition of Offences 2005, Internal Wiring 2005, Resellers of Local Calls Operating Coinafons Notification 2007 and Prescribed Trusts 2017), each in the 2002 or 2004 Revised Edition with the gazetted amendments IMDA lists to 2016 (the last two groups as made), read from IMDA's copies (an aid); with the e-Gazette's copy of 25 of the amendments deposited beside the IMDA copy and compared (NOTES.md finding 23; the Gazette's copies of S 685/2011 and S 686/2011 replace the OCR text of IMDA's image-only copies); and eighteen instruments IMDA's list lacks, from the e-Gazette: S 114/2001 (Rg 5 as made) with its 2001 amendments S 339/2001, S 373/2001, S 374/2001 and S 450/2001, S 516/2001 (the Composition Regulations as made), S 115/2001 (N 1 as made), S 525/2001 and S 78/2017 (N 1), S 485/2016 (Rg 3), and the eight designation notifications S 86/2005, S 233/2005, S 390/2007, S 23/2011, S 24/2011, S 35/2012, S 192/2012 and S 521/2017. On 2026-11-04, from the team lead's follow-up list: the TAS-era Order O 3 (S 549/1998 and the 1999 Revised Edition), the 1999 Revised Editions of the Dealers Regulations (Rg 7) and the Radio-communication Regulations (Rg 3), S 588/2023 (N 1), S 589/2023 (Rg 6), S 560/2024 (Composition), S 381/2024, S 559/2024 and S 852/2024 (Wiring Work), and eight Acts and one Order after Act 15 of 2017 that amend the Act (Acts 26 and 40 of 2018, 15 of 2019, 12 of 2020, 4 and 25 of 2021, 13 of 2026, and, on the second list of 2026-11-04, Act 31 of 2022 with its commencement notification S 850/2022, and G.N. No. S 26/2022); and, from the same second list, S 362/2001 (an amendment of Rg 7), S 185/2003 (Rg 6 as made), S 48/2004 and S 593/2004 (its two amendments of 2004), Bill 24/2022 (extrinsic) and the 2010 Subject Index (an AID, an index as at 1 June 2010, not law); and S 22/2011, the Telecommunications (Cancellation) Notification 2011 (it cancels thirteen exemption notifications, which are not deposited), found by the independent reviewer. Deposited with their text under subjects/sg/telecommunications-* (a reliance on SSO's terms cl.13 for IMDA's copies and on the e-Gazette's Terms of Use cl.11 for the Gazette's, not a clearance from IMDA, the Attorney-General's Chambers or the e-Gazette).

scope: The whole Act (all 98 sections, Parts 1 to 9) and every deposited instrument (73 texts in seventeen groups), with no deferred rows: Meng's ruling of 2026-11-03. Every row of COVERAGE.md is encoded, a fork row (pointing at TV-QUESTION.md section 4), or inert for one of the three reasons the brief allows. The functions that answer for a date before 2 October 2026 answer from the deposited printed texts on two time axes (the day of the conduct and the day the law is read as at) where the Act's text is deposited, and NOTHING otherwise, unless labelled an inference (sgta-ta-vintage.l4). The Code of Practice S 87/2005, the Telecommunication Authority of Singapore Act (including its section 30), any amendment of the 1999 Dealers Regulations other than S 362/2001, and any amendment of the 1999 Radio-communication Regulations after 1 July 1999 are not deposited: each has a row marked source not obtained in NOTES.md.

not_reviewed: No domain expert has read this encoding against the sources; a second Claude session (not a domain expert) read it once, see independent_review. The Act's text for 16 May 2018 to 1 October 2026 is not wired into the seat's version table (eight Acts and one Order after Act 15 of 2017 are deposited as enacted, sgta-i-acts-after-2017.l4, but the seat still answers those days from the consolidation's margin markers; Acts 22 and 30 of 2016 and Act 15 of 2017 are deposited; the Singapore Statutes Online consolidations by date are not deposited, and no attempt was made: the Broadcasting Act encoder's single attempt at 03:07:48 SGT on 2026-11-04 ended in a 403 at robots.txt, which was the gate; three amending Bills were read through lawplain for the s 2 definitions only and are not deposited); the instruments' text is an aid from IMDA's copies, checked against the e-Gazette's copy for 25 amendments and five more; the Code of Practice S 87/2005 has not been found. Answers for dates in the gap are NOTHING (strict) or an inference from the Act's own amendment markers and the three Bills (labelled).
links_to_other_folders: see NOTES.md, register of links; Broadcasting Act facts are plain inputs; Interpretation Act s 9A is cited, not re-encoded.
